reason: The first reading was checked against the Gallican psalter, which corrected 'eius(?) meo semper' to '[conspe]ctu meo semper', showed that 37:7 omits 'sum', and fixed the order of the four faces.

text:
Source-assisted reading of Stams, Stiftsarchiv, Frg. 167 (F-p8ik), made on the native images with the Gallican psalter (Stuttgart Vulgate text; Patrologia Latina 28, cols. 183-186) at hand. Reread on the image: all 28 lines by a research reader; the 14 lines of canvas 1 (faces labelled 1v and 2v) again by an independent checker, whose readings are given for those faces. Given in the order of the text: face 1r, then 2v below it (recto of the leaf); face 1v, then 2r below it (verso). Regions x,y,width,height in native pixels. ( ) expansion; [ ] lost or supplied; ? uncertain; (red X) red verse initial; | the cut between the strips.
